description.value:
You live for speed, whether behind the controls of a swoop bike, a pod racer, or something with even fewer safety features. The rush of a photo-finish and the taste of a hard-won victory are what get you out of bed.

You've read more stretches of dangerous terrain at speed than most pilots read at a crawl, and you know how to shave a shortcut out of a route everyone else considers impassable.

toolProficiencies: One type of gaming set or mechanic's kit
system.equipment: A set of common clothes, a trophy or ribbon from your first win, a gaming set of your choice, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
